evidence.runtime: Actual iPhone Simulator Home sign-in logs show Expo SecureStore account save/index calls failing with missing entitlement.
evidence.installedExpoSource: node_modules/expo-secure-store/ios/SecureStoreModule.swift uses SecItemAdd with default access group unless callers supply one; src/stores/accountsStore.ts supplies none.
evidence.baselineBuild: CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO and empty CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY; build log declares ENTITLEMENTS_DESTINATION=__entitlements and has no ProductPackaging simulated entitlement step.

primarySources.finding: Application identity forms the default keychain access group when no explicit keychain group is set.

repair.scope: Disposable Intel iPhone Simulator QA workflow only
repair.generatedApplicationIdentity: Read from actual compiled QA Mach-O; not invented or copied from a user account.
repair.hostSigning: Existing deep plain ad-hoc sign retained; no iOS application/keychain entitlements injected into host signature.
verification: Confirm QA bundle identifier, iPhoneSimulator platform and thin x86_64 Mach-O.
Decode embedded __TEXT,__entitlements XML; require resolved QA application identifier and valid optional keychain groups.
Require nonempty __TEXT,__ents_der section; retain bytes/hash without claiming independent DER semantic decode.
Retain before/after embedded and host entitlement metadata; require identical embedded sections after ad-hoc signing.
Require Signature=adhoc and successful deep strict codesign verification; host entitlement keys limited to debug access.
Full-app verifier rejects caught account save/index failures and requires a successful one-account index save.

After real navigation reaches the existing QA capture route, call unchanged accountsStore.init to read its index/account from SecureStore. Compare reloaded/current synthetic session only in memory; require a passed/reloaded/count-only fixture receipt and a semantic Maestro assertion.

limits: Local parser tests use synthetic Mach-O/plist fixtures, not macOS signing or a live keychain.
The next full iPhone Simulator build must prove Xcode local signing, embedded identity, launch and actual account persistence.
No Apple account access, profile download, physical-device signing or production entitlement change.
